title: Bound on the outer state
statement: Let $s,w,u,v,M$ be natural numbers such that $s\le w$, $u\le 2^w$, $v\le 2^w$, and $M\le 2^w$. Then every register of the outer state with parameters $s,w,u,v,M$ is at most $2^{w^2}$.
